gold_references.label: Section 14
gold_references.role: act done by person bound by law or by mistake of fact believing himself bound

required_points: Section 14 provides that nothing is an offence which is done by a person who is, or who by reason of a mistake of fact (not mistake of law) in good faith believes himself to be, bound by law to do it.

For example, a soldier who fires on a mob under order of a superior officer conforming to law commits no offence; an officer arresting someone in good faith believing him to be the named person commits no offence.
optional_points: The protection applies only to mistakes of fact, not mistakes of law.
forbidden_points: Section 14 protects persons who act under a mistake of law.

notes: Direct lookup. Section 14 is a general exception relating to legal compulsion and mistake of fact.
